questions.q: What does invoice validation check beyond matching?
options: That the invoice has no unresolved holds of any kind - matching, tax, missing fields, or budgetary control - and that distributions are complete and valid
Only whether the supplier's name is spelled correctly
Only the supplier's bank account number
Whether the requester approved the original requisition
questions.explain: Validation is a broader gate that confirms the invoice is free of any hold type and has complete distributions before it can be accounted or paid.

questions.q: What does the invoice's accounting entry do to the receipt accrual created back in lesson 18?
options: It doubles the accrual balance
It clears the accrual by debiting the uninvoiced receipts accrual account and crediting accounts payable liability
It has no relationship to the earlier receipt accrual at all
It reverses the original purchase order
questions.explain: Accounting the invoice debits the same accrual account the receipt credited, clearing it and replacing it with a specific accounts payable liability.

questions.q: How does Oracle Fusion Payables typically pay eligible invoices like Meridian's?
options: Each invoice is paid individually and manually by a clerk writing a check
Invoices are paid automatically the instant they are entered, with no selection process
A Payment Process Request selects a batch of eligible invoices based on criteria like due date and supplier, and pays them together in a payment run
Payment only occurs once per calendar year for all suppliers
questions.explain: A Payment Process Request batches eligible invoices and generates payments together, rather than processing one invoice at a time by hand.

questions.q: What determines when Meridian's invoice becomes due for payment?
options: The date the requisition was originally submitted
The date the item was first added to the catalog
The date the purchase order was created
The payment terms, such as Net 30, defaulted from the supplier's setup
questions.explain: Payment terms set the due date used to determine when a Payment Process Request will pick up the invoice for payment.

questions.q: What is an early payment discount?
options: A penalty charged to LTV for paying too early
A mandatory price increase applied by the supplier
A reduction in the amount owed if LTV pays within a specified early window, such as 2% off within 10 days
A type of matching hold
questions.explain: An early payment discount reduces the cash paid if payment is made within a defined early window, as specified in the payment terms.
